c74object.name: evi.wavefolder~
c74object.digest: Anti-aliased wavefolder device for shaping oscillators, simultaneous outputs up to four stages
c74object.description:
evi.wavefolder~ is a 'max define' for the evi_wavefolder.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.wavefolder~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does.
An analog model of the 'Lockhart Wavefolder' employing antiderivative anti-aliasing via Lambert-W functions. The waveshaper takes a simple audio signal and aggressively folds and clips it to produce new shapes and harmonics in the style of west coast synthesis. This 'simple' version has a fixed cascade for four simultaneous outputs of 4 stages, 3 stages, 2 stages or 1 stage. See evi.wavefolder.cascade~ for a version with more options.

inlet.description: Audio input to be wavefolded, typically a simple oscillator.

c74object.discussion: Based on the paper: 'Virtual Analog Model of the Lockhart Wavefolder' by Fabian Esqueda, Henri Pontynen, Julian D. Parker, Stefan Bilbao, SMC, 2017.
